summary: The source partitions rows and CSR data across ranks. The measured loop invokes the warp kernel when local average row length selects it, otherwise the thread-per-row kernel, exactly once for each requested repetition, followed by synchronization. The warp kernel iterates all row nonzeros by lane stride and reduces/stores; the thread kernel traverses the complete row interval and stores its sum. The bound executable contains both selectable final-sm86 kernels with the corresponding row/nonzero loops and stores.
